source_candidate_selection.rule: maximum upstream out_probs then candidate_id ascending

actions.name: NORMALIZED_TEXT
actions.text_rule: lowercase, strip, collapse ASCII whitespace, then exact preregistered VOC mapping

actions.name: HFLIP_CANONICAL
actions.image_rule: exact horizontal pixel reversal; canonical text; reverse output masks to original coordinates

actions.name: LOCAL_CROP_FROM_CANDIDATE
actions.crop_rule: expand source half-open bbox about its center using floor lower and ceil upper bounds, then clip
actions.resize_rule: no project-side resize; official SAM single-image preprocessing applies
actions.restore_rule: place crop mask in clipped crop window and set outside pixels false

actions.name: BOX_REFINE_FROM_CANDIDATE
actions.box_rule: source half-open bbox converted to normalized XYWH

actions.name: POINT_REFINE_FROM_CANDIDATE
actions.feasibility: canonical source candidate and upstream object ID exist
actions.point_rule: maximum four-connected erosion depth inside source mask; row-major y,x tie-break; pixel center normalized
actions.replay_rule: fresh session, canonical prompt replay, then point refinement on source upstream object ID

oracle_tie_break: higher IoU, then lower measured incremental action cost, then action code order A0 through A6
